checks: Data: re-read the six 1.7" Harada Table 13 intensities (HCN, HCO+ 1-0/3-2, CS 2-1/5-4) for N, S, C from lit/harada_table13_parsed.csv; they match the worker's inputs. Model-independent line ratios N/S HCN/HCO+ = 1.49 (1-0) and 1.85 (3-2) are recovered.

Independent re-derivation (team/checks/q39r1_check.py): own RADEX-grid fit using grid_fine.npz, ln-eta grid, no band scales, species columns minimised independently. Best chi2 N 5.5, S 0.77, C 1.00 (worker 5.1/0.57/0.94 with band-scale freedom): agree, so the Q35 chi2=10 at N was largely grid coarseness. Profile of delta=log[N(HCN)/N(HCO+)]_N - _S: min at +0.2 dex (ratio 1.6), delta=0 has dchi2=4.1 (2.0 sigma). Agrees with worker's profile 2.1 sigma. Marginal P=1.00 of Q35 is therefore not reproduced; the downgrade is correct.

The claims in the report entries are calibrated: ~2 sigma (profile), non-Gaussian, 6 data and ~6 parameters, confidence low; N(HCO+)/N(CS) downgraded to 1.6 sigma; the fixed-band-scale 2.7 sigma is reported but explicitly not adopted; HCN/CS 0.9 sigma; Bridge/S null. N-cap 17/18 sensitivity gives the same result. Q35 entry carries a supersession note. Two-gas result (no preference, CS column unconstrained) is honestly stated; the 9-parameter model on 6 points is not informative, and the worker says so.

No conflict with forum posts p0038/p0039/p0040 (those concern CO opacity/filling and the HCN/HCO+ line-ratio contrast, not RADEX columns). The result sharpens p0038: the N/S excess is robust in line ratio but only ~2 sigma as an abundance ratio after excitation.
notes_for_questioner: (1) The N posterior is bimodal (hot Tk at the 300 K cap vs cold/dense thick branch); H13CN/H13CO+ at 4-3 or 1-0 on a common beam is the discriminator, and it is already data-limited (S H13CN ~1 sigma). Consider a question on whether any existing 2017.1.00379.S line (H13CN 4-3 upper limits at N/S/C, matched aperture) can exclude the thick branch. (2) Tk is unconstrained; an HCN/HCO+ 4-3 vs 3-2 ladder point at 1.7" from the ALMA cubes (rather than Harada only) would add two lines per species and break the Tk/n degeneracy; worth asking whether the 4-3 and 3-2 data can be matched in beam/uv to 1.7". (3) Suggest the published statement of the N-HCN-rich claim be phrased as 'line-ratio excess robust; abundance excess ~2 sigma, reference dependent'.
